bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; allowing certified chaplains in public schools; appropriating money; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 121A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[121A.395] CERTIFIED SCHOOL CHAPLAINS.

Subdivision 1.

Definitions.

As used in this section, "certified chaplain" means a chaplain certified by a national or state chaplaincy organization or ecclesiastically endorsed by a religious organization.

Subd. 2.

School chaplain.

(a) A school district or charter school may employ or accept as a volunteer a certified chaplain to provide support, services, and programs for a student, staff member, or legal guardian of a student as authorized by the board of a school district or charter school.

(b) A certified chaplain employed by or volunteering at a school under this section is not required to be licensed by the Professional Educator Licensing and Standards Board.

Subd. 3.

Background studies.

The board of a school district or charter school must initiate a criminal history background study for each individual hired or volunteering under this section. The background study must include a review of information from the Bureau of Criminal Apprehension, including criminal history data as defined in section 13.87, and must meet all background check requirements under section 123B.03.

Subd. 4.

Prohibition.

A school district or charter school must not employ or accept as a volunteer under this section an individual who has been convicted of any offense that requires the person to register as a predatory offender under section 243.166, or a crime under a similar law of another state or the United States.

Subd. 5.

Cause of action.

A cause of action does not arise against a certified chaplain for an action taken or statement made while providing support, services, or programs for a student, staff member, or legal guardian of a student, unless the action or statement was maliciously, willfully, and deliberately intended to cause harm to, harass, or intimidate an individual seeking the support, services, or programs provided by the certified chaplain.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATIONS; SCHOOL CHAPLAINS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sums indicated in this section are appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education in the fiscal years designated.

Subd. 2.

School chaplains.

For the purposes of providing salaries, training, oversight, and governance of school chaplains under Minnesota Statutes, section 121A.395:
